title: S3.7c zero-radius sphere-locus projection and distance

scope.geometry: Mathematical projection and signed radial distance for the sphere locus, including radius zero as the singleton center point
scope.parser_profile: Generated parser-fed ACIS BinaryFile 21800 sphere surface
scope.projection_policy: For a zero-radius locus, every finite query has the unique closest point at the center; nonzero-radius center projection remains ambiguous and is refused.
scope.distance_policy: Signed radial distance is distance-to-center minus magnitude(radius); for radius zero it is distance to the center point.
scope.model_validity_policy: Rooted ACIS projection coverage continues to classify zero radius as a known model-validity gap; utility support is not promoted to valid ACIS surface or B-rep support.
non_claims: validity of a zero-radius ACIS surface or solid
